# Kyoto 5-Day Trip Overview

A relaxed Kyoto plan for **2 adults** with a **USD 2,400** on-the-ground budget, centered on **temples, food markets, and easy walking**. The itinerary is grouped to reduce backtracking and keep each day comfortable.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Timeline

### Day 1: Higashiyama Welcome Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and settle near central Kyoto or Gion.
- Afternoon: Easy stroll through **Gion** and **Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka**; stop for tea and sweets.
- Food: Kaiseki lunch or a casual tofu set near Higashiyama.
- Evening: **Kiyomizu-dera** at late afternoon, then a calm dinner in Gion.
- Action: [Button: View area map](https://www.japan-guide.com/e/e3931.html)

### Day 2: Central Temples and Nishiki Market
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Visit **Nishiki Market** before crowds build.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Visit **Nishiki Market** before crowds build, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Walk to **Teramachi** and **Shinkyogoku** for light shopping and café stops.
- Food: Market tasting lunch with small shared plates.
- Evening: **Nijo Castle** or a relaxed riverside walk if energy is low.
- Action: [Button: Explore Nishiki](https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/)

### Day 3: Arashiyama Nature and Temples
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** and **Tenryu-ji**.
- Afternoon: Easy riverside walk near Togetsukyo Bridge and optional boat or café break.
- Food: Matcha dessert stop or soba lunch.
- Evening: Return early for a quiet dinner; keep this day light.
- Action: [Button: Plan Arashiyama](https://www.japan-guide.com/e/e3950.html)

### Day 4: Northern Kyoto Shrine and Temple Circuit
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: **Kinkaku-ji** for an early visit.
- Afternoon: Continue to **Ryoan-ji** and, if pace allows, **Ninna-ji**.
- Food: Simple lunch near the temple corridor or back in town.
Media: Alt=Food: Simple lunch near the temple corridor or back in town, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Optional onsen-style relaxation or a slow dinner near Kyoto Station.
- Action: [Button: Temple route](https://www.japan-guide.com/e/e3950.html)

### Day 5: Philosopher’s Path and Final Food Stops
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Walk a short section of the **Philosopher’s Path** and visit nearby temples.
- Afternoon: Last shopping stop for tea, yatsuhashi, or kitchenware.
- Food: Final lunch in **Gion** or **Higashiyama** with a view or courtyard seating.
- Evening: Pack, transfer, and depart.
- Action: [Button: Kyoto walking areas](https://www.japan-guide.com/e/e3929.html)

## Area-Based Activity Map

### Higashiyama / Gion
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Best for: iconic temple scenery, historic streets, tea houses.
- Key stops: Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Ninenzaka, Gion.
- Walking level: easy to moderate, best done as a slow half-day.

### Central Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Best for: food markets, casual shopping, flexible dining.
- Key stops: Nishiki Market, Teramachi, Shinkyogoku, Kyoto Station area.
- Walking level: easy, with many rest stops and indoor breaks.

### Arashiyama
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Best for: bamboo grove, river scenery, gentle nature.
- Key stops: Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, Togetsukyo Bridge.
- Walking level: easy if you keep the route compact.

### Northwest Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Best for: major temples with straightforward transit.
- Key stops: Kinkaku-ji, Ryoan-ji, Ninna-ji.
- Walking level: easy between sites, best with one taxi or bus hop.

### Eastern Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Best for: scenic strolling and temple clusters.
- Key stops: Philosopher’s Path, Nanzen-ji area, nearby cafés.
- Walking level: easy and ideal for a relaxed final day.

## Budget Breakdown Chart

| Category | Planned Amount | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel / stay | USD 1,050 | 5 nights for 2 adults in a comfortable midrange stay |
| Food & drinks | USD 620 | Markets, lunches, dinners, snacks, tea stops |
| Local transport | USD 180 | Subway, buses, occasional taxi for convenience |
| Admissions | USD 220 | Temples, gardens, castle entries, small extras |
| Shopping / souvenirs | USD 180 | Tea, snacks, crafts, small gifts |
| Buffer | USD 150 | Weather, upgrades, flexible spend |
| Total | **USD 2,400** | Excluding flights |
